description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90/3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Critical Chance +50% (25s)]/[MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to the user, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Wedge)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Critical Chance +50% (25s)
description.text: Critical chance +50% (additive with other critical chance sources)

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Wedge)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Wedge)], removes [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Wedge)]
